inicio.subtitulo: Design a space mission with limited mass, power and budget.
inicio.instrucciones: Choose a destination, design your ship, pick a launcher and launch. Then find out why your mission succeeded or failed.

objetivo.ayuda: Delta-v is the change in speed your ship needs to reach the destination. Farther destinations need more delta-v.

diseno.masa_seca_ayuda: A heavier ship needs more propellant and a stronger launcher.
diseno.area_paneles_ayuda: Bigger panels give more power, but sunlight gets weaker far from the Sun.
diseno.isp_ayuda: A higher Isp gives more delta-v with the same propellant.

lanzador.aviso: Capacities are maximum published values under different conditions, and costs come from different years. Use them as a reference, not as exact prices.

resultados.sin_resultado: No result yet. Launch a mission first.
